claims.quote: Wild-collected rosy barbs, originating from the vicinity of Calcutta (the type locality of Barbus conchonius), look completely different from the aquarium strains.

Feral populations have been established in Singapore, Australia, Mexico, Puerto Rico, and Colombia.
